requirements.text: The page shows the menu with prices, so coffee lovers and office staff nearby can see each item and what it costs before they visit.
The page has a pre-order form for pickup, so coffee lovers and office staff nearby can pre-order a coffee and collect it at the shop.
The page shows the shop's map or address, so visitors can find where Brew Lab is in Indiranagar, Bengaluru.
The page shows the opening hours, so visitors can check when Brew Lab is open.
The site is one page only: the menu, pre-order form, map or address and opening hours are all on that single page.
The site works on phones: a visitor on a phone can read the menu with prices, the opening hours and the address, and can fill in and send the pre-order form.
The site has no payment: the pre-order form does not ask for or take any online payment.

components.name: Menu display
components.responsibility: shows each menu item with its price so visitors can see what things cost before they visit

components.name: Pre-order form
components.responsibility: lets a visitor pre-order a coffee for pickup and collect it at the shop, and asks for no online payment

components.name: Shop address
components.responsibility: shows the shop's map or address so visitors can find Brew Lab in Indiranagar, Bengaluru

components.name: Opening hours
components.responsibility: shows when Brew Lab is open so visitors can check before they come

components.name: One-page layout
components.responsibility: holds the menu, pre-order form, map or address and opening hours on one page and keeps them readable and usable on a phone

elements.behaviour: the Pre-order form for pickup is sent when every required field is filled in. If a required field is empty or invalid, the form is not sent and the problem is shown beside that field. No payment is asked for or taken
that field is checked when the visitor leaves it, and its message is shown beside it. The fields and their rules are listed under Form fields
a message shows that the pre-order for pickup was received, so the visitor knows it went through
each link moves the visitor to `#menu` (S1), `#pre-order` (S2), `#shop-address` (S3) or `#opening-hours` (S4) on the same page

revisions.reason: The LLD slice lists a quantity field, select, number and time field types and ids such as #pre-order-submit, #pre-order-fields and #pre-order-status. The charter and the Requester's answer say four fields (name, phone, items, pickup time) with no quantity, and the atom allows only the #po-* ids. I followed the charter. Mailto cannot confirm receipt, so there is no separate status element.
